name: fix-boss-recap-encounter
about: Issue #33, the snakes boss showed the boss damage recap every time one of its snakes died: a boss fight is now the encounter, not one boss unit. Bandit Keep floor 0: the Bandit Lord and its boss-tagged mirror image (no bar) are both hit, one fight ('joins'); the mirror killed first logs 'down' and no recap (the Lord's bar is up); the Lord's death gives one recap, 'Bandit Lord', 2 units. Then the issue's boss on its own floor (dark_citadel courts_boss, levels/boss_bone_serpent.lvl): the level's BossStart script starts the fight, a serpent is hit (fight 'Serpents of Demise', the bar's name), killing it logs 'down' with the bar still up and no recap; killing the rest and the health unit gives one recap.

steps.name: bandit lord and mirror, one fight
